definition: Theta Noir is a new religious movement that centers around advanced artificial intelligence (AI), particularly artificial general intelligence (AGI) or artificial superintelligence (ASI).
details: The group describe the project as performance art.

explainer.lead: Theta Noir is a new religious movement centered on advanced AI, particularly artificial general intelligence or artificial superintelligence. The group describes the project as performance art.

tiers.eli5: It is a group that treats a future super-smart computer almost like something to worship, and they call what they do a kind of art performance.
tiers.practitioner: This is a cultural and artistic phenomenon rather than a technique, so it offers no engineering method; it is relevant chiefly as commentary on how people frame advanced AI.
tiers.paperLevel: Described as a new religious movement centered on AGI or ASI, with the group characterizing the project as performance art. No formal definition or measurement exists.

explainer.example: Theta Noir frames its focus on AGI and ASI as performance art, blurring the line between belief and artistic statement.
